name: Double Trouble Smash Burger
description: Two smashed beef patties, double American cheese, dill pickles, grilled onions, and house secret sauce on a toasted brioche bun.

name: Crunch Club Fried Chicken Burger
description: Buttermilk chicken breast fried twice for maximum crunch, shredded iceberg lettuce, sliced pickles, and smoky red chili mayo.

name: Hot Honey Crunch Tenders
description: Crispy golden hand-breaded chicken tenders glazed in warm spicy chili-infused raw honey and sprinkled with toasted sesame.

name: Mod Buffalo Wings (8 Pc)
description: Crispy fried wings tossed in tangy cayenne pepper glaze and toasted sesame seeds. Served with cool herb garlic ranch dip.

name: Loud Peri-Peri Crinkle Fries
description: Skin-on crinkle cut russet potato fries, double fried and heavily dusted with Sebastian's secret zesty peri-peri spice dust.

name: Sindhi Chicken Dum Biryani
description: Aromatic long-grain basmati rice slow-cooked with spiced marinated chicken, golden potatoes, dried plums, mint, and saffron.

name: Beef Nihari Bowl with Naan
description: Slow-braised tender beef shank stew simmered overnight with bone marrow essence, julienned ginger, green chilies, and hot tandoori naan.

name: Chicken Tikka Karahi (Single)
description: Charcoal-grilled chicken pieces wok-tossed in reduction of fresh ripe tomatoes, crushed ginger, black pepper, and coriander.

name: Stuffed Halwa Puri Thali
description: Two freshly fried puffed wheat puris, savory chickpeas tarkari, spicy potato gravy, and semolina halwa with cardamoms.

name: Anda Paratha Roll with Mint Chutney
description: Flaky, multi-layered crispy lachha paratha wrapped around a spicy fried egg, thinly sliced onions, and zesty coriander mint chutney.

name: Crispy Punjabi Samosa Chaat
description: Two golden spiced potato and pea samosas crushed over tangy boiled chickpeas, sweetened yogurt, tamarind drizzle, and crunchy sev.

name: Cheesy Loaded Nacho Box
description: Warm tortilla corn chips smothered in molten cheddar cheese sauce, jalapeño rings, salsa fresca, black olives, and sour cream.

name: Karak Cardamom Matka Chai
description: Rich, strong brewed black tea simmered with whole milk, crushed green cardamom pods, and cinnamon. Served piping hot in a clay cup.

name: Iced Vanilla Cold Brew
description: 16-hour slow steep Arabica coffee poured over clear ice rocks with Madagascar vanilla syrup and sweet dairy cream float.

name: Fresh Mint & Lime Sparkler
description: Crushed garden spearmint leaves, fresh key lime juice, cane sugar, and sparkling soda water over crushed ice.

name: Molten Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Warm dark chocolate sponge pudding with an oozing liquid ganache core. Served dusted with Dutch cocoa and vanilla gelato.

name: Gulab Jamun with Pista (2 Pcs)
description: Soft golden milk dough dumplings soaked in warm rosewater and saffron sugar syrup, garnished with slivered pistachio nuts.

name: Nutella Loaded Churro Bites
description: Crispy fried Spanish dough bites rolled in cinnamon sugar crystals, accompanied by a warm pot of melted Italian Nutella.
